The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] was '''besieged''' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during a battle between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and those of the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] in the Sy Myrth area. The Imperial [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]] was directed by the expert guidance of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] during the siege, and the Imperial forces eventually pulled away with a win. Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] was also present for the siege. The siege was part of the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]], in which Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]] attempted to eliminate the remnants of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] army in the Sy Myrth region after the latter's defeat at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the Empire's predecessor, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It took place after consecutive Imperial victories during the Sy Myrthian Insurrection on the worlds [[Battle of Diado|of]] [[Diado]] [[Battle of Metalorn (Imperial Period)|and]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]], and was followed by a [[Battle of Trasemene|battle]] at the world of [[Trasemene]], which also resulted in an Imperial victory.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="Warfare" />
